TitleSlide.description:
A freestanding title or credits element (add-titles-and-credits design.md
D5) for the placements "at the start of the movie", "before an element" and
"at the end": it refers to no medium and has its own display duration, like
an image element (default `TITLE_DURATION_DEFAULT`).

Exactly one of `lines` (layouts `one-line`/`two-line`) and `creditEntries`
(layout `credits`) is set; the other is null. There is no `title` field: a
title element can never hold an overlay title of its own (spec
slideshow-project), and `extra="forbid"` rejects one.

get.description: All known exports (since the backend started), oldest first.

post.description:
Starts an export of the saved project as it is right now.

Later changes to the project do not affect this export.
At most one export runs at a time; a second start returns 409.

422.description: Empty project (`export.emptyProject`), missing media (`export.missingMedia`, `export.missingMusicMedia`) or FastAPI's native list (file name rules carry `export.fileName.*` as `type`)

delete.description:
Cancels a running export or deletes a finished one.

- `queued`/`running`: the export is cancelled (FFmpeg stopped, partial file
  deleted); the response comes only afterwards. The job stays queryable as
  `cancelled`, without a file.
- `done`/`failed`/`cancelled`: file and job are deleted; 404 afterwards.

get.description:
The finished MP4 as a download with the requested file name (`<fileName>.mp4`).

As long as the export is not `done`, the server answers 409 with the
status; an incomplete file is never served.
All imported media in import order.

413.description: More than 50 files in one request (`media.tooManyFiles`)

delete.description:
Deletes a medium with its files and removes it from the project (cascade).

All storyboard elements using this medium are dropped together with their
incoming transitions; the new first element has no transition. All music
clips using it are dropped as well (the following clips move up).

The response is 200 with the updated project (instead of 204) so that the
client can adopt its state without another GET /api/project.

Order: first from the media store, then from the project. A concurrent
PUT /api/project validates against the media store and therefore cannot
re-insert the ID afterwards.

While a `queued` or `running` export has the medium in its snapshot, the
response is 409 (`media.inUseByExport`); medium, project and export stay
unchanged (design.md D5).

409.description: A queued or running export uses the medium (`media.inUseByExport`)

get.description:
Audio preview version (AAC in M4A, 48 kHz, stereo) with `Cache-Control: immutable`.

404 for images as well as unknown IDs. Range requests are supported.

Waveform data (50 peaks per second, mono, 0..1) with `Cache-Control: immutable`.

404 for images as well as unknown IDs.

Video poster frame (JPEG, quality 90) with `Cache-Control: immutable`.

404 for images, audio and unknown IDs (add-video-import D3).
Preview image (JPEG, longest edge <= 1920) with `Cache-Control: immutable`.

Original video file (its own container/codec) with `Cache-Control: immutable`.

For the preview player's `<video>` element (add-timeline-editing design.md D5); export
reads the same file directly from disk. 404 for images, audio and unknown IDs. Range
requests are supported (needed for the browser to seek).
The saved project; without a file, the empty project.

put.description: Replaces the project. On 422 the saved state stays unchanged.

422.description: Invalid project: `project.invalid` with one issue per broken reference, or FastAPI's native list (rule violations carry an error code as `type`)
